verdict.rationale: PagerDuty's Post-Incident Reviews feature explicitly includes AI-generated PIRs (now GA) that integrate incident lifecycle data, Slack, and the Scribe Agent to build chronological incident narratives, uncover systemic patterns (contributing factors), and coordinate preventative follow-up actions — closely matching the story's timeline/contributing factors/follow-ups structure, with teams starting PIRs from the incident detail page for review. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of AI PIR draft quality and explicit description of the human-review/edit workflow before finalization.
